Handling window dragging
content:
A frameless window needs a draggable region. Use the `q-electron-drag` and `q-electron-drag--exception` Quasar CSS helper classes. ```html ... ``` The class allows the user to drag the window from that region. Interactive children must not trigger dragging. [QBtn](/vue-components/button) is excluded automatically; add `q-electron-drag--exception` to other interactive children.
